mechanics.claim: Once a target has 3 Organic Deconstruction stacks it becomes Researched, and while Researched the beam (and other Vel'Koz sources) deal true damage instead of magic damage.
Researched status lasts 7 seconds and refreshes on basic attacks or ability hits against the target, so it can be maintained indefinitely in a sustained fight.
mechanics.quote: marks them as ''Researched'' for 7 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and ability hits against them

mechanics.claim: The channel can be ended early by recasting (available 1 second into the channel), which stops further damage ticks; it otherwise ends automatically at the maximum duration.
The ability's cooldown does not begin until the channel (including any recast) ends, not on initial cast.
There is a 0.2-second delay after activation before the beam and its damage actually begin.
